Synthetic Debt Transformation: Combining floating bank debt with a fixed-payer swap locks borrowing costs.
Asset Transformation: Swapping fixed bond coupons for floating benchmark returns immunizes asset portfolios.
Intermediary Bid-Ask Spread: Swap banks quote two-way prices, capturing riskless spreads on matched books.
Comparative Advantage Surplus: Quality spread differentials between fixed and floating debt unlock mutual arbitrage gains.
Zero Initial Value Invariant: Fixed swap rates are set so that initial net present value is exactly zero.
Bond Portfolio Decomposition: Swaps can be valued as a long floating bond and a short fixed bond: V_swap = B_fl - B_fix.
Replacement Credit Risk & CCPs: Credit risk is strictly net replacement cost, protected by mandatory CCP variation margin.
ui_state.bottomTakeaway: Plain vanilla interest rate swaps form the $500 Trillion backbone of global finance, enabling synthetic liability management and risk immunization.
